invitations_single_outcome.name: invitations_single_outcome

rma_documents_xml_validated.name: rma_documents_xml_validated
rma_documents_xml_validated.value: "rma_documents"."kind" <> 'nota_xml' or ("rma_documents"."validation_status" is not null and "rma_documents"."rules_version" is not null)

rmas_cancellation_consistent.name: rmas_cancellation_consistent
